title: Bella Hadid donates $50,000 for winter shelter kits for displaced Gaza families
summary_full: Bella Hadid has pledged $50,000 to provide urgent shelter for families in Gaza. This generous donation will fund waterproof tents, blankets, and mattresses for 100 families displaced by the ongoing crisis. As winter conditions worsen and flooding becomes more severe, the demand for shelter has soared. Hadid appeals for others to join the cause, highlighting the essential need for survival and dignity amidst this humanitarian disaster.
